seasonal_trope_proposal.name: The castle dresses for the occasion
seasonal_trope_proposal.status: PROPOSED_FROM_OWNER_REQUEST; not a new binding design rule
seasonal_trope_proposal.constant: Familiar shell castle architecture, existing room identity/fixtures, physical door routes, unobstructed action surfaces and walking lanes
shared_slots: Upper cornices, door surrounds and balcony/bridge rails: ribbon/paper garlands
Quiet side/base clusters: seasonal lamps or props
Existing textiles: small cushion, towel, canopy or napkin accents
Room-specific display surfaces: one centerpiece, craft display or shelf ornament
seasonal_trope_proposal.halloween: Orange/plum ribbons, rounded paper bats, friendly white cloth ghosts, smiling pumpkins and shell/leaf accents
seasonal_trope_proposal.room_variation: The same theme adapts to cooking, reading, crafts, toys, performance, water, dining, sleeping and watching movies rather than copying one generic arrangement everywhere.
seasonal_trope_proposal.future_use: Swap seasonal motifs on the same known dressing locations for future owner-requested holidays, preserving room identity.
seasonal_trope_proposal.future_runtime_boundary: Production should retain approved original pixels and preserve child-authored banner/logo copies. Existing whole-sprite/owned-alpha and overdraw rules remain binding. Determine each complete decoration's draw ownership, avoid painted-copy duplicates, then review actual Canvas/phone states; this board authorizes no new runtime layers.

visual_review.reviewer: Codex direct inspection of generated board against inspected source art
visual_review.observations: All 14 labelled panels visible: exterior plus all 13 registry rooms, including every family-wing room. Bright lavender/aqua shell world, coherent orange/plum seasonal accents; recognizable kitchen, reading, stage, craft, pool, bath, dining, sleeping and movie fixtures. Pool retains rainbow waterfall and recognizable seahorse fountain; sleepover shows three distinct beds. No HUD or new human character.
visual_review.limits: Generated details and fixture placement are interpretive, not pixel-locked. Exterior invents surrounding landscape and compresses architectural proportions; Main Hall compresses its long door run and cannot establish route completeness; Stuffie Playroom furnishings/plush arrangement and other room details drift. Labels are adult-board annotations only. Do not copy invented surroundings, shifted fixture geometry or compressed door counts into runtime. The board proposes holiday dressing only; exact fixture/portrait/banner identity and performance need later owner/source review.
